import sys

def find_greeting(s):
    word = 'hello'
    i = 0
    for l in s:
        if l == word[i]:
            i += 1
            if i == len(word):
                break
    return 'YES' if i == len(word) else 'NO'

data = sys.stdin.read()
first_line = data.splitlines()[0] if data.splitlines() else ''
res = find_greeting(first_line)
print(res)
